substrate: Charades full-core watch path (fovea saccade + sense temporal evidence)

vs_single_frame_workaround.note: the single-frame workaround OVERSTATED recall (judged EVERY frame, no fovea). The real fovea COASTS + saccades -> 69% fewer calls but drops low-motion action windows (edge recall 0.70).

diagnosis: Recall bottleneck is UPSTREAM at the FOVEA: edge/motion-gate candidate_recall 0.70 -> 30% of action windows never trigger a saccade (low-motion persistent actions: holding/watching/standing) so are never judged. Of the 70% admitted, judge+gate convert ~43% to in-window fires. Precision 0.47 (better than single-frame's 0.375: fewer, better-timed fires). This is the G2 recall-vs-cost trade-off (P-ECON): the fovea's 69% call cut costs recall on low-motion actions; lowering escalate_threshold/base_fps raises recall at higher cost.
